title: Binary Clock
description: Interactive p5.js simulation displaying current time in binary format using vertical LED columns, teaching binary number representation and time reading skills.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Binary Clock
Binary Numbers
Time Display
LED Display
p5.js
learningObjectives: Convert a column of lit LEDs to its decimal digit by adding the place values 2^0, 2^1, 2^2, and 2^3 from bottom to top
Read the current time in HH:MM:SS format by decoding each vertical binary LED column
Explain why four LEDs per column are sufficient to represent any decimal digit from 0 to 9
Distinguish lit LEDs (binary 1) from unlit LEDs (binary 0) when translating between binary and decimal representations
